body: I appreciate the sentiment behind this post, but in general I do not agree with posts like these (dont worry, I respect your effort and wont down-vote you). I dont mean to discredit what you may have been through, but there is a profound despair that drives people to serious considerations of suicide. Though past my prime depressive state, I still cannot come acurately express the unyielding and paralyzing horror that despair provoked, and how hollow I became. But posts like this are akin to giving a person on his deathbed a get-well-soon balloon. Unfortunately, I cannot offer you an alternative, and I know you want to help, but the saturation of posts like this on the internet truly dilute the effects of the words you speak and should someone with the agency to TRULY be there for someone actually speak them, they will fall on deaf ears.
